touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Owston Ferry qualifies as a local detour through Kinaird motte and bailey castle and CHURCH OF ST MARTIN. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Owston Ferry: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Owston Ferry offers Kinaird motte and bailey castle, CHURCH OF ST MARTIN, SLUICE AND ROAD BRIDGE AT OUTFALL OF SNOW SEWER/WARPING DRAIN INTO THE RIVER TRENT within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Kinaird motte and bailey castle
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Kinaird motte and bailey castle and CHURCH OF ST MARTIN, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: SLUICE AND ROAD BRIDGE AT OUTFALL OF SNOW SEWER/WARPING DRAIN INTO THE RIVER TRENT
